title: Help a friend: say it simply
objective: Reformuler une information simple pour aider un pair

steps.title: Warm-up: guess the word
steps.student_instruction: Explain a word without saying it (It's a kind of..., you use it to...). Your partner guesses.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Jeu de type Taboo avec des mots du quotidien ; noter au tableau les tournures de paraphrase utilisées.

steps.title: Listening: Eating out
steps.student_instruction: Listen to Jamie and Sally at a restaurant. Note what they order.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Demander ensuite d'expliquer simplement starter et main course à un camarade.

steps.title: Language focus: paraphrase
steps.student_instruction: Learn: It means..., It's a kind of..., It's like..., In other words..., Do you understand?
steps.facilitator_instruction: Insister sur la simplicité : phrases courtes, mots connus, vérification de la compréhension.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet with the restaurant menu.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : associer mots et définitions simples ; B : expliquer cinq plats ; C : reformuler une consigne compliquée pour un élève nouveau.

steps.title: Mediation in threes
steps.student_instruction: A reads a notice or menu, B doesn't understand, C helps with simple English. Rotate roles.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Groupes de 3 ; observer la reformulation (pas de traduction mot à mot) et la vérification de la compréhension.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Explain one difficult word from today in one simple sentence.

sheets.student_content: Match the words and the simple explanations: starter / main course / dessert / menu - (a) the sweet dish at the end (b) the list of food (c) the first dish (d) the big dish.
sheets.facilitator_correction: starter = c ; main course = d ; dessert = a ; menu = b.

sheets.student_content: Your friend doesn't understand the menu. Explain five items in simple English: French onion soup, tomato salad, Thai chicken, mineral water, fresh orange juice.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : French onion soup is a hot soup made with onions. Thai chicken is a kind of spicy chicken with rice.

sheets.student_content: Rewrite this school notice for a new student who is learning English: 'Students are reminded that the library will be closed for refurbishment until further notice.'
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : The library is closed now because they are repairing it. We don't know when it will open again.

criteria: L'élève reformule avec des mots simples
L'élève vérifie la compréhension de son pair
L'élève transmet l'information sans la déformer

common_errors: Phrase trop longue pour être comprise
Oubli de vérifier : Do you understand?
